verdict: ready for frozen fixed-input execution; actual numerical success remains unmeasured

scope.method: P1 finite-volume reconstruction, one affine cell factor, global Lax-Friedrichs a4, SSPRK(3,3),CFL.4
scope.reference: closed symmetric non-vacuum fan; splitGauss conserved means; separate existing log-root Riemann evaluator

review_findings.finding: P1 endpoint quadrature weights1/2; globalLF alpha0=1. Actual endpoint spectra and all FE-substep dt*a/dx<=1/2 are checked. This is a conditional theorem applied to this recorded run, not an a priori universal stage speed bound.
Central reconstruction q±one half-slope and one common affine scaling preserve each conserved mean in real arithmetic; measured floating-point defects are gated.
SSPRK stages q1=FE(q0),q2=3q0/4+FE(q1)/4,q3=q0/3+2FE(q2)/3 are checked separately. Net actual boundary flux weights1/6,1/6,2/3 and per-FE/per-combination/full-step budgets are correct.
Raw nonpositive densities are counted without undefined pressure division; scaled endpoints and FE/SSP means must be admissible. No cell-average floors or silent retry path exists.
Closed star and symmetric fan formulas satisfy head/tail continuity; pointwise agreement with the independent root evaluator, splitGauss8/16, symmetry and Euler residual are planned.
AtT.15 all exact fan fronts are inside[0,1]. Initial integral[1,0,3]+.15*far-field net flux[-4,0,-13.6]=[.4,0,.96] is independently asserted in test25.

Pre-execution plot source reads only hashed saved conserved arrays and stage records. Preview axes are x and time, not two spatial dimensions. Pressure is p(conserved mean), not mean pointwise pressure.

limitations: This is a positive non-vacuum central state, unlike the different actual-vacuum input in the cited paper.
Positivity is not a TVD,entropy stability or global convergence theorem.
Bibliographic records, inspected formulas and actually executed software are distinguished in the source reviews.
